value.rationale: The 2026 motivating paper identifies a specific third-specialization collision and conjectures stronger fourth-specialization recovery. The infinite family proves the loss at three colours is systematic in every available order 3r+6 while a single low-degree fourth-specialization coefficient separates every family member. This gives a meaningful structural boundary at the frontier of a published reconstruction problem rather than merely extending a finite census.
